
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/wecandoallthings/p/19292590" title="发布于 2025-12-01 14:02">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">python代码封装成可执行文件</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>首先确保python源码可以成功运行<br>之后执行命令如下<br>python -m pip install pyinstaller<br>先使用命令下载安装pyinstaller打包工具<br>之后直接在脚本所在的目录下执行打包命令(打包成单个exe文件)<br>pyinstaller -F -w -i icon.ico your_script_name.py</p>
<p>-F：打包成单个可执行文件（方便分发）<br>-w：不显示控制台窗口（GUI 程序必备）<br>-i icon.ico：设置程序图标（可选，需提前准备.ico 格式图标）<br>your_script_name.py：你的脚本文件名（比如email_sender.py）<br>执行成功后会在目录中生成个dist文件<br>将dist文件夹中的 exe 文件（及所需配置文件）分发给用户，双击即可运行，无需安装 Python 或任何依赖！</p>
<p>注意事项<br>1. 运行路径问题：打包后的 exe 会在自身所在目录读写文件（如email_config.json、secret.key），需确保这些文件与 exe 同目录<br>2. 杀毒软件误报：部分杀毒软件可能误报打包后的 exe，可添加信任<br>3. 兼容性：在 32 位系统打包的 exe 可在 32/64 位系统运行，64 位系统打包的 exe 仅能在 64 位系统运行</p>
<p><br>我的python代码如下:</p>

@staticmethod
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> send_email(smtp_server, smtp_port, sender_email, password, receiver_email, subject, content, is_html=False, attachments=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">None):
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">发送单封邮件</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 连接SMTP服务器</span>

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 发送邮件（支持多个收件人）</span>

server.sendmail(sender_email, receivers, msg.as_string())
server.quit()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> True, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">发送成功</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> False, str(e)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> -------------------------- 线程类（避免UI卡死） --------------------------</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SendEmailThread(QThread):
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">邮件发送线程</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

log_signal = pyqtSignal(str, str, str) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 日志信号（时间、收件人、状态）</span>
all_finish_signal = pyqtSignal() <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 全部发送完成</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__init__</span>(self, config, receivers, subject, content, is_html, attachments, delay=1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
super().</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__init__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">()
self.config </span>= config <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 邮箱配置</span>

self.subject =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> subject
self.content </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> content

self.delay </span>= delay <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 发送间隔（避免被邮箱服务器限流）</span>
self.is_running =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> True

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stop(self):
self.is_running </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> False

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> run(self):
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> receiver <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.receivers:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.is_running:
self.log_signal.emit(datetime.datetime.now().strftime(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>), receiver, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">发送取消</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

success, msg </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EmailSender.send_email(
smtp_server</span>=self.config[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">smtp_server</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
smtp_port</span>=self.config[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">smtp_port</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
sender_email</span>=self.config[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sender_email</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
password</span>=self.config[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">password</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
receiver_email</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">receiver.strip(),
subject</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">self.subject,
content</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">self.content,

attachments</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">self.attachments
)

log_time </span>= datetime.datetime.now().strftime(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
log_status </span>= f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">成功: {msg}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> success <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">失败: {msg}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 发送间隔</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">time.sleep(self.delay)

self.all_finish_signal.emit()

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TimerSendThread(QThread):
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">定时发送线程</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
timer_signal </span>= pyqtSignal(str) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 倒计时信号</span>
start_send_signal = pyqtSignal() <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 开始发送信号</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__init__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(self, target_time):
super().</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__init__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">()
self.target_time </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> target_time
self.is_running </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> True

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stop(self):
self.is_running </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> False

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> run(self):
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.is_running:
now </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> datetime.datetime.now()
diff </span>= (self.target_time -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> now).total_seconds()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> diff &lt;=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
self.start_send_signal.emit()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 计算倒计时</span>
hours = int(diff // 3600<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
minutes </span>= int((diff % 3600) // 60<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
seconds </span>= int(diff % 60<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
self.timer_signal.emit(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{hours:02d}:{minutes:02d}:{seconds:02d}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
time.sleep(</span>1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> add_receiver(self):
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">添加收件人</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> receiver_text:

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> receiver <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> receivers:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> receiver <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.receivers:

self.receiver_input.clear()

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> import_receivers(self):
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">导入收件人文件（TXT/Excel）</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
file_path, _ </span>= QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(self, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">选择收件人文件</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">文件 (*.txt *.xlsx *.xls)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> file_path:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
receivers </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> file_path.endswith(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.txt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):

receivers </span>= [line.strip() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> line <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> f <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> line.strip()]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span>: <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Excel</span>
df =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pd.read_excel(file_path)
receivers </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> df.iloc[:, 0].dropna().astype(str).tolist()

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 去重并添加</span>
new_receivers = [r <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> r <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> receivers <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> r <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.receivers]
self.receivers.extend(new_receivers)
self.update_receiver_table()
QMessageBox.information(self, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">成功</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">导入成功！新增 {len(new_receivers)} 个收件人</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
QMessageBox.warning(self, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">错误</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">导入失败：{str(e)}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> update_receiver_table(self):
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">更新收件人表格</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
self.receiver_table.setRowCount(len(self.receivers))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i, receiver <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> enumerate(self.receivers):

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> clear_receivers(self):

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> add_attachment(self):

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> start_send(self):
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">开始发送邮件</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 验证配置</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.config:

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 验证收件人</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.receivers:
QMessageBox.warning(self, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">警告</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">请添加至少一个收件人！</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 验证邮件内容</span>
subject =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.subject_input.text().strip()
content </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.content_edit.toPlainText().strip()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span> subject <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> content:
QMessageBox.warning(self, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">警告</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">主题和正文不能为空！</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 定时发送</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.timer_checkbox.isChecked():
target_time </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.timer_edit.dateTime().toPyDateTime()
now </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> datetime.datetime.now()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> target_time &lt;=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> now:
QMessageBox.warning(self, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">警告</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">定时时间必须晚于当前时间！</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 启动定时线程</span>
self.timer_thread =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TimerSendThread(target_time)
self.timer_thread.timer_signal.connect(self.update_countdown)
self.timer_thread.start_send_signal.connect(self.do_send)
self.timer_thread.start()
self.send_btn.setEnabled(False)
self.stop_btn.setEnabled(True)
QMessageBox.information(self, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">提示</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">定时发送已设置！将在 {target_time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')} 开始发送</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 立即发送</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">self.do_send()

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> do_send(self):
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">执行发送（真正的发送逻辑）</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 构建配置</span>
send_config =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sender_email</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: self.config[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sender_email</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">password</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: self.config[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">password</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">smtp_server</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: self.config[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">smtp_server</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">smtp_port</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: self.config[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">smtp_port</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取邮件信息</span>
subject =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.subject_input.text().strip()
content </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.content_edit.toPlainText().strip()
is_html </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.html_checkbox.isChecked()
delay </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.delay_spin.value()

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 启动发送线程</span>
self.send_thread =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SendEmailThread(send_config, self.receivers, subject, content, is_html, self.attachments, delay)
self.send_thread.log_signal.connect(self.add_log)
self.send_thread.all_finish_signal.connect(self.send_finish)
self.send_thread.start()

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 更新按钮状态</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">self.send_btn.setEnabled(False)
self.stop_btn.setEnabled(True)
self.countdown_label.setText(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">发送中...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stop_send(self):
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">停止发送</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> self.timer_thread <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.timer_thread.isRunning():
self.timer_thread.stop()
self.timer_thread.wait()
self.countdown_label.setText(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">倒计时：--:--:--</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> self.send_thread <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.send_thread.isRunning():
self.send_thread.stop()
self.send_thread.wait()

self.send_btn.setEnabled(True)
self.stop_btn.setEnabled(False)
self.add_log(datetime.datetime.now().strftime(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>), <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">系统</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">发送已取消</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> send_finish(self):
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">发送完成</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> add_log(self, time_str, receiver, status):
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">添加发送日志</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
row </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.log_table.rowCount()
self.log_table.insertRow(row)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 时间</span>
time_item =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> QTableWidgetItem(time_str)
time_item.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
self.log_table.setItem(row, 0, time_item)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 收件人</span>
receiver_item =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> QTableWidgetItem(receiver)
receiver_item.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
self.log_table.setItem(row, </span>1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, receiver_item)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 状态（成功绿色，失败红色）</span>
status_item =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> QTableWidgetItem(status)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">成功</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> status:
status_item.setForeground(Qt.GlobalColor.green)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
status_item.setForeground(Qt.GlobalColor.red)
status_item.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
self.log_table.setItem(row, </span>2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, status_item)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 滚动到最后一行</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">self.log_table.scrollToBottom()

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> update_countdown(self, countdown_str):
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">更新倒计时</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
self.countdown_label.setText(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">倒计时：{countdown_str}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> closeEvent(self, event):
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">关闭窗口时停止线程</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> self.send_thread <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.send_thread.isRunning():
self.send_thread.stop()
self.send_thread.wait()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> self.timer_thread <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.timer_thread.isRunning():
self.timer_thread.stop()
self.timer_thread.wait()
event.accept()

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> -------------------------- 主函数 --------------------------</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__name__</span> == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">__main__</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
app </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> QApplication(sys.argv)
window </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AutoEmailSender()
window.show()
sys.exit(app.</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">exec</span>())</pre>
</div>
<p>以上是一个邮件群发系统,方便同事联系客户,进行群发</p>
